title: 2021 Panini Illusions #72 Kyle Pitts Atlanta Falcons Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Kyle Pitts 2021 Panini Illusions card is a must-have for any football card collector. The card features Pitts in his Atlanta Falcons rookie season, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. The card number is #72 and it belongs to the base set of the 2021 Panini Illusions series.

This card is in near mint or better condition, making it a great choice for collectors who are looking for high-quality cards. The card is perfect for fans of the National Football League (NFL) and for those who love collecting sports trading cards. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this Kyle Pitts card to your collection!
